contract.variant: Turkish get-up with a high bridge, bell in the left hand; the knee sweeps into a half-kneel, then the lifter stands up with the feet together
contract.counting: One full get-up to standing and back down
contract.phases: Lie with the bell pressed; roll onto the planted right elbow; post on the hand; high bridge; sweep the straight leg under the hips so the knee lands with the shin pointing back; push off the hand to an upright half-kneel; stand up from the lunge, stepping the back foot up beside the front foot, and stand tall; reverse every step
contract.contacts: Bell-side foot planted throughout; elbow, hand, heel, knee and back toes pinned in their stages (the back toes slide in as the weight moves forward before the step); back and forearm roll on the floor during the roll; bell arm locked and vertical throughout; eyes on the bell on the floor
sources: Girls Gone Strong: Mastering the Turkish get-up
